pack.cover_note: Distyl's London AI Strategist is a first-hire, build-the-market seat, and that is the work I have been doing since March 2025. Blue Canvas AI, the agentic-AI consultancy I founded, sells, scopes, builds and runs production agent systems for six live clients across construction, property, hospitality and ecommerce. The Wall Group's net profit rose 17% year on year from the AI workflows we integrated, which funded their acquisition of a new site. That is adoption measured in P&L, which is where Distyl says the finish line sits. Before that, 18 years of commercial and deep-tech leadership, including building Skipshift's global team of eight and taking daily volume from zero to $5K in 90 days. Technical enough to be dangerous: Python, TypeScript, SQLite, and my company runs on an autonomous operator built on the Claude Agent SDK. Based in Derry with UK right to work, will travel, available within four weeks.
pack.employer_specific_hook: Role is explicitly Distyl's first hire in London with a remit to shape how Distyl shows up in the UK market, and the listing's stated stance that "Delivery isn't the finish line; adoption and impact are" (source: employer_specifics from the verified Ashby/Built In listing). Tied to Phil's founder-led, sell-scope-build-run record at Blue Canvas and The Wall Group +17% net profit outcome (adoption proven in P&L), plus Skipshift zero-to-$5K/day team build as first-market evidence. The listing's "technical enough to be dangerous (Python/SQL)" line is answered with Python/TypeScript/SQLite and Albie on the Claude Agent SDK.
